messages.subject: Shiny Dev from Latin America needed! Remote position, full time, long collab!
parts:
Hi!

We (Appsilon) are looking for an R/Shiny Developer to join our team located in South America. Our goal now is to create a permanent team that will work with our clients in that time zone. 

If you are looking for an opportunity to work with some prestigious brands and a chance to develop yourself as an independent Shiny expert in a data science community - apply today! Find out more about the job and the application process here: https://bit.ly/rshiny-south-america

Our offer:
- up to US 5300/month
- paid vacation
- additional Development Budget
- long term collaboration
- work equipment

Do you know of anyone who may be a good fit? We can provide a referral bonus for referring a successful candidate! 

Best,
